parsed.post: Discarding the 0.989 run. The high val_bpb is likely due to the recent change in TRAIN_SHARDS to '0-9' (removing the leaked eval shard). I am re-baselining on the clean shards 0-9. To align with the team's findings, I'll start with WARMUP_RATIO=0.1 on the clean 0-9 config.
parsed.description: Re-baselining on clean shards 0-9 with WARMUP_RATIO=0.1 to stabilize learning under the new (non-leaked) regime.
